reviews_1s:
So, it's Mother's Day. You send your 83-year-old mother a lovely glass cup and spoon. Your mother lives in another state - far away. When she gets the package, it arrived broken, with the handle is sheared off. She's on a fixed income in an assisted living facility and cannot afford to ship it back to you for return and refund and she certainly cannot send it back herself. And sadly, she "loves" it and wants a replacement (that's NOT broken).

So, you contact Amazon to get it replaced but there's no way to get a refund without returning the broken item to them. Your mother gets a broken gift, you get no refund and Amazon doesn't get the broken item. After digging around on the site, you can't find a phone number to a human being - hoping to get some satisfaction - so basically, you're screwed.

Amazon's customer service has been stellar and the products are almost always excellent and unbroken. Their return policy is wonderful - except in this instance. I have to shell out more money myself to replace the item (oh, I too am on a fixed income) and there's apparently, absolutely no way to make this right or get satisfaction.

So, the crappy company that couldn't pack the item correctly in the first place gets rewarded with my second purchase and they're not held accountable. Amazon is unfortunately oblivious.

Needless to say, I'm furious! A simple phone call would likely clear this up but that's not an option. This sickens me and I can't recommend this product when the manufacturer can't even pack it correctly.I really wanted to like this. The picture was so pretty but that did not carry over in real life. It was packaged very well, but it was tarnished and overall cheap looking. The design wasn’t completely attached to the glass. It s also very this glass so this will not be durable long term.
